info.name: Get a list of all Group Enrollment Plans

params.description: The unique identifier of the group enrollment for which you would like to view the plans

items.docs: Returns a list of all plans for a given group enrollment.

info.name: Get a list of all Group Enrollments

params.name: group_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the group for which you would like to view group enrollments

params.name: effective_date
params.description: The relative date on which to view the state of the record

params.name: status
params.description: The status of the group enrollments you would like to view

params.name: page_size
params.description: The max size of each page of results

params.name: offset
params.description: The integer offset at which to start the page. Possible values are 0 to total_records - 1

items.docs: Returns a list of all group enrollments for a given group.
